name: yamm
description: Mail merge for Gmail and Google Sheets with YAMM (Yet Another Mail Merge): send a personalized email to each person on a list in a Google Sheet, from your own Gmail account, merged from a Gmail draft. Send yourself a test email first, then follow the sending and track opens, clicks, replies, bounces and unsubscribes.

interface.longDescription:
YAMM (Yet Another Mail Merge) is a mail merge for Gmail and Google Sheets. ChatGPT can use it to send a personalized email to each person on a list in a Google Sheet, merged from a Gmail draft and sent from your own Gmail account. Your sheet then shows who opened, clicked, replied, bounced or unsubscribed.

Use a Gmail draft and a Google Sheet to send personalized emails. You can send yourself a test email first. ChatGPT asks for confirmation before starting the mail merge.

What you can do:

- Send yourself a test email, merged from your draft and the first row of the sheet
- Send a mail merge to every visible row of a sheet: filter or hide rows to send to only part of your list
- Follow the sending progress
- See opens, clicks, replies, bounces and unsubscribes for a campaign
- See poll answers when the email includes a poll
- Check your plan and how many recipients you can email now
- Get YAMM help articles for setting up the sheet and the draft

How it works:

YAMM sends through your Gmail account and writes each row's status in a Merge status column of the sheet. It skips addresses that bounced or unsubscribed before.

Authentication through OAuth: you sign in with your Google account and grant YAMM access to Gmail and Google Sheets.

YAMM has been installed more than 16 million times and is rated 4.7/5 by more than 18,000 users. Built by Talarian, the team behind Autosheet, Awesome Table and Form Publisher.
